entries.title: Psalms 118:1
segments: ¶O give praise to the Lord, for he is good: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 118:2
segments: Let Israel now say, that his mercy is unchanging for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 118:3
segments: Let the house of Aaron now say, that his mercy is unchanging for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 118:4
segments: Let all worshippers of the Lord now say, that his mercy is unchanging for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 118:5
segments: I made my prayer to the Lord in my trouble: and the Lord gave me an answer, and put me in a wide place.

entries.title: Psalms 118:6
segments: The Lord is on my side; I will have no fear: what is man able to do to me?

entries.title: Psalms 118:7
segments: The Lord is my great helper: I will see my desire against my haters.

entries.title: Psalms 118:8
segments: It is better to have faith in the Lord than to put one's hope in man.

entries.title: Psalms 118:9
segments: It is better to have faith in the Lord than to put one's hope in rulers.

entries.title: Psalms 118:10
segments: All the nations have come round me; but in the name of the Lord I will have them cut down.

entries.title: Psalms 118:11
segments: They are round me, yes, they are all about me; but in the name of the Lord I will have them cut down.

entries.title: Psalms 118:12
segments: They are round me like bees; but they are put out like a fire among thorns; for in the name of the Lord I will have them cut down.

entries.title: Psalms 118:13
segments: I have been hard pushed by you, so that I might have a fall: but the Lord was my helper.

entries.title: Psalms 118:14
segments: The Lord is my strength and my song; he has become my salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 118:15
segments: The sound of joy and salvation is in the tents of the upright; the right hand of the Lord does works of power.

entries.title: Psalms 118:16
segments: The right hand of the Lord is lifted up; the right hand of the Lord does works of power.

entries.title: Psalms 118:17
segments: Life and not death will be my part, and I will give out the story of the works of the Lord.

entries.title: Psalms 118:18
segments: The hand of Jah has been hard on me; but he has not given me up to death.

entries.title: Psalms 118:19
segments: ¶Let the doors of righteousness be open to me; I will go in and give praise to the Lord.

entries.title: Psalms 118:20
segments: This is the door of the Lord's house; the workers of righteousness will go in through it.

entries.title: Psalms 118:21
segments: I will give you praise, for you have given me an answer, and have become my salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 118:22
segments: The stone which the builders put on one side has become the chief stone of the building.

entries.title: Psalms 118:23
segments: This is the Lord's doing; it is a wonder in our eyes.

entries.title: Psalms 118:24
segments: This is the day which the Lord has made; we will be full of joy and delight in it.

entries.title: Psalms 118:25
segments: Send salvation now, O Lord; Lord, send us your blessing.

entries.title: Psalms 118:26
segments: A blessing be on him who comes in the name of the Lord; we give you blessing from the house of the Lord.

entries.title: Psalms 118:27
segments: The Lord is God, and he has given us light; let the holy dance be ordered with branches, even up to the horns of the altar.

entries.title: Psalms 118:28
segments: You are my God, and I will give you praise; my God, and I will give honour to your name.

entries.title: Psalms 118:29
segments: O give praise to the Lord, for he is good: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.
